programmes.d: Much rests on the battle between Yugi and Atem.
Atem calls the Egyptian gods in his battle against Yugi.
Yugi claims to be able to beat Atem.
Yugi and Atem finish their duel.
Kaiba kidnaps Yugi's grandfather to get a rare card.
Yugi loses his grandpa's soul to Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus.
Yugi helps Joey board the boat for Duelist Kingdom to save his sister's eyes.

Once Yugi and his friends reach Duelist Kingdom, Pegasus announces that there are many strange secrets on the island; Weevil begins to use mysterious new rules against Yugi in a duel and Yugi must figure the rules out and master them to survive.
Fisherman duelist Mako baits Yugi into a disadvantageous battle.
Joey undergoes his first duel on the island against Mai Valentine, a professional duelist with an uncanny ability to predict the cards she will draw.
Yugi fights Kaiba's younger brother for control of Kaiba Corporation.
Yugi must develop new strategies for battle.
An unseen helper aids Yugi in battle with Seto.
At the Duelist Kingdom, the duel is on; Yugi must defeat Weevil Great Moth, which gains power with every turn.
Joey engages in individual battle with Rex Raptor.
Joey duels valiantly, but Dinosaur Ryuzaki unleashes his secret weapon, Red-Eyes Black Dragon; Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi's gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi's help.
Yugi's classmate, possessed by the Millennium Ring's powers, traps Yugi and friends in a shadow game.

Panik cheats Mai of all her Star Chips and Yugi vows to get revenge on him and win them back; when Panik's Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, Yugi must defeat an enemy he cannot see.
Despite his disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes Panik and tells him that he'll finish him in three turns.
Kaiba descends to the Kingdom to face Pegasus; powerful dragon cards determine the outcome.
When Joey is abducted, he is faced with zombies.

Joey's last-ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith's zombie monsters; as his lucky streak comes to an end, his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him.
Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and Joey join forces to battle against the Labyrinth Brothers; the battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus's castle is on the line.
The Paradox Brothers summon the Gate Guardian to defeat Joey and Yugi.
The Paradox brothers appear to be unbeatable with three elemental guardians.
Yugi and Joey attempt to gain entrance to Pegasus' castle.
Yugi worries because Kaiba seems different in their rooftop battle.
Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life.
As Yugi reels from his loss, Téa volunteers to duel with Mai, but her inexperience puts her in danger of losing.
Kaiba plans to duel Pegasus over Mokuba's soul.
Pegasus' Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities leave Kaiba helpless; as the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba's soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba.
Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus; Tristan tries to uncover Pegasus' secrets.
Distracted by Pegasus, Yugi makes tactical errors during his duel with Mai.
Mai rebounds after losing to Joey; a loss to Kaiba weighs on Yugi's heart.
Joey searches for a card that allows him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it.
Joey mimics Keith's battle strategy.
Joey challenges Yugi to a duel.
Yugi is shocked when Joey uses the Time Wizard card -- a card Yugi gave him as a token of friendship.
Yugi finally faces Pegasus in a battle to reclaim the souls of his loved ones.
Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him.
Yugi finds a way to counter Pegasus's mind-reading ability and destroy Pegasus's Toon World; the next level of the Shadow Game is about to begin.
Yugi's friends yell encouragement as he collapses, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness.
When Pegasus summons a fearsome monster, Yugi counters by calling forth the smallest creature in the game.
An Egyptian named Shadi enters Yugi's mind using the Millennium Key.
A girl claims Grandpa stole a powerful card from her family long ago.
Yugi teaches Rebecca that success depends on the player's heart, not the cards.
Kaiba becomes trapped inside a virtual-reality game.
The quest to rescue Kaiba continues with a little help from Mai, but Yugi and friends must adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way.

Yugi rescues Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game; the only exit is past the five-headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba and Mai lose all their life points; Yugi and Kaiba must put aside their animosity to face the dragon.
